categories.name: overview
categories.label: Overview
categories.headline: From concept to launch
paragraphs: Launch a fully branded online store with product management, payments, multilingual support, SEO tools, and a modern administration interface.
Built on modern technologies including Payload CMS, Next.js, TypeScript, and Stripe, the platform is designed for performance, flexibility, and long-term growth.
Available as a managed SaaS subscription or a lifetime licence, the platform helps businesses launch faster without building from scratch.

categories.name: features
categories.label: Features
categories.headline: Everything you need to start selling online

items.title: Branding & Domains
items.description: Custom domain, logo, colours, and full theme control so the storefront matches your brand — not a template look.

items.title: Product management
items.description: Products, variants, categories, pricing, and media in one admin, with draft and live preview before you publish.

items.title: Storefront Experience
items.description: Carts, favourites, guest checkout, order history, secure order lookup, and discount codes at checkout.

items.title: Payments & Payouts
items.description: Stripe Connect Express — shoppers pay into the merchant's own Stripe account, with a smooth checkout and order emails.

items.title: Content and SEO
items.description: Landing pages and content via a layout builder (heroes, grids, carousels, CTAs, forms), plus SEO settings — no separate page-builder app.

items.title: Shipping and languages
items.description: Flat-rate shipping zones, optional Sendcloud live rates, and multilingual storefronts (en / da / de / es) with translation workflow in admin.

items.title: VAT & Tax Settings
items.description: Set default and country VAT rates in store settings. Catalog and shipping stay gross; checkout shows the VAT portion without adding tax on top.

categories.closing: Integrated and deployment-ready — a solid foundation for launching and growing a branded online store.
